monitored_text: Direct Metal Laser Sintering (DMLS) and Selective Laser Melting (SLM) What is Direct Metal Laser Sintering and Selective Laser Melting ? Direct Metal Laser Sintering (DMLS) and Selective Laser Melting (SLM) utilize high-powered lasers to selectively melt and fuse metal powder to produce parts with high levels of accuracy and tight dimensional tolerances. This technology creates parts with excellent durability and robust mechanical properties.
